[P2] Test permanent checkpoint failures after handler rejection

The new late-failure composed case only injects a 503; the existing wrapper unit tests keep `isTerminationRequested()` false. Removing this classification guard would therefore leave those cases passing while a late 400 validation failure would be rethrown instead of returning `FAILED`. CONTRIBUTING.md rule 4 requires a test that distinguishes this branch. Add a composed case where the handler throws with async SUCCEED pending and that checkpoint then fails with an execution-scoped error; assert a resolved `FAILED` response and exactly one `FAILED` invocation-end notification.
